extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: The Aetna plan available in Pasco County has a $20 monthly premium, a $400 drug deductible and a $3100 maximum out-of-pocket.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent followed all compliance rules, delivered the disclaimer before discussing benefits, collected the Scope of Appointment, and scheduled a plan review. The customer was kept informed and engaged throughout the call.
composition.coaching_note: Great job, Luis! You effectively followed all the necessary steps and engaged the customer well. One improvement would be to ensure the customer is aware of the exact time for the appointment, as it was mentioned as '2 hours from now' without a specific time. This can help avoid any confusion.
